ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_FACTAVERAGEDAILYBALANCEMTD]  AS
BEGIN


INSERT INTO DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD
(
     BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)

SELECT 
BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK AS BranchSK
,BankSK AS BankSK
,AccountSK AS AccountSK
,AccountId AS AccountId
,(SUM(BalanceAmountFull) OVER (PARTITION BY AccountSK,MONTH,YEAR ORDER BY BusinessDateSK))/DAY AS AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFulll  --[20230831 - Karl]
,(SUM(BalanceAmountProrated) OVER (PARTITION BY AccountSK,MONTH,YEAR ORDER BY BusinessDateSK))/DAY  AS AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated
,SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM 
dw.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance A -- no enchancement yet
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMDATE B ON B.DateSK = A.BusinessDateSK
WHERE
NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT * FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD B
    WHERE 
    A.BusinessDateSK = b.[BusinessDateSK]
    and A.AccountId = b.AccountId 
)

END
GO
